parameters.help_en:
Parameters that define the failover conditions. A failover is triggered when one of the following conditions is met: An explicit stream disconnection occurs, such as an end-of-file (EOF) or network error. The stutter rate exceeds 60% in the last 5 seconds. A stream pulling timeout occurs if no frame data is received for 2 consecutive seconds. The average frame rate over the period specified by `ali_max_no_frame_timeout` drops below `ali_low_frame_rate_threshold`. This condition applies even if there is no stream disconnection or stuttering. If you set `ali_max_no_frame_timeout`, the timeout for Condition 3 is also updated to this value. If `block_all_jitter` is set to `1`, Conditions 2, 3, and 4 do not apply. `ali_max_no_frame_timeout`: an integer from 2 to 10.
`ali_low_frame_rate_threshold`: an integer from 1 to 200.
`block_all_jitter`: `0` or `1`.
parameters.help_zh:
切流相关的配置参数

明确发生断流时（eof 或 net err），立刻触发主备切换；
最近5秒内卡顿率超过60%，立刻触发主备切换；
拉流超时，持续2秒收不到帧数据，触发主备切换；
未断流、未发生卡顿，但是最近ali_max_no_frame_timeout时间内的平均帧率 小于 ali_low_frame_rate_threshold，立刻触发主备切换。如果用户设置了 ali_max_no_frame_timeout 参数，则3的超时时间会同步更新成 ali_max_no_frame_timeout。
开启 block_all_jitter 则2、3、4不生效。

取值范围：
10 > timeout > 2
200 > threshold > 1
block的值为0或1
